def test_summarize():
    # Test 1: Basic counts
    jobs1 = [
        {"status": "new"},
        {"status": "applied"},
        {"status": "rejected"},
        {"status": "other"},
    ]
    assert summarize(jobs1) == {'new': 1, 'applied': 1, 'rejected': 1, 'other': 1}

    # Test 2: Case sensitivity and whitespace
    jobs2 = [
        {"status": " NEW "},
        {"status": "Applied"},
        {"status": "REJECTED"},
        {"status": "other"},
    ]
    assert summarize(jobs2) == {'new': 1, 'applied': 1, 'rejected': 1, 'other': 1}

    # Test 3: Missing or None status
    jobs3 = [
        {"status": None},
        {"status": ""},
        {"status": "new"},
        {"job_id": 1},  # missing status
    ]
    assert summarize(jobs3) == {'new': 1, 'applied': 0, 'rejected': 0, 'other': 3}

    # Test 4: Empty list
    jobs4 = []
    assert summarize(jobs4) == {'new': 0, 'applied': 0, 'rejected': 0, 'other': 0}

    # Test 5: No modification of input
    jobs5 = [{"status": "new"}]
    summarize(jobs5)
    assert jobs5 == [{"status": "new"}]

if __name__ == "__main__":
